dataset.title: nano-vesicles (NETs) data
dataset.description: We will make the proposed nano-vesicles (NETs) available to interested investigators who would like to use them in their scientific research. The dataset includes data obtained from the study on nano-vesicles (NETs) as photo-theranostic materials for fluorescence imaging and photothermal therapies.
